verdict.rationale: Tensor throughput is a fair axis for a GPU, but the evidence pack contains no TFLOPS or TOPS figures, no stated precision such as FP4, FP8 or BF16, and no sparsity qualifiers. The only performance claims are relative marketing multipliers ("3X training, 15X inference" versus the previous generation), which are exactly the bare numbers the story rejects. The other specs in the pack, GPU memory (1,440 GB) and NVLink bandwidth (14.4 TB/s), are not tensor throughput.
